title: Bounded certificate run
statement: Let $P$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean symbols and $k_P$ work tapes, and let $k$ be a natural number. Let $\iota$ be an injection from the $1+k_P$ tape slots into the $k$ tape slots, and choose a slot $c$ outside its image. For Boolean words $x,y$, let $d$ be a configuration of $P$ on input $x$ with a nonhalting state. Choose a Boolean tag satisfying the boundary-tag condition at $d$’s input-head position, a position $p$ among the $|y|+2$ positions, and arbitrary contents and head positions for the $k$ tapes. If the run of $P$ from $d$ is halted at time $D$, then the certificate machine, started from the configuration built from these data, is halted at some time $t\le D+4$; its output is the one-symbol word whose symbol is true exactly when the output of $P$ at time $D$ is the one-symbol word $[\mathrm{true}]$.
